provenance: reference/house-template.md v2.0 - measured across eight issued workbooks, 128 sheets, of which 59 carry the BILL OF QUANTITIES head band and are bill pages; 660 pages measured for the font reading; 341 pages for the 62-row rhythm
supersedes: reference/takeoff-format.md (LEGACY v1 - A4 landscape, Calibri 8.9, six columns, fully ruled). A workbook built to the old format is not the issued house format.

sheet.note: the band is not one size. An earlier reading assumed 10 pt throughout and was wrong.

columns.carries: spacer - no value, no vertical rule
description overflow; the head band's BILL OF QUANTITIES and section title; To Collection

columns.note: the house value is 14.711, the plurality. An earlier reading of the reference named 15.711 - the third most common - and was corrected against the workbooks.

column_gate: fail any deviation on A to G; accept 14.5 to 18.0 on H alone

cover_sheet_geometry.note: a cover is not a bill page and is not held to the bill-page widths

visual_note: B, C and D are one visual cell - no vertical rule falls between them, so the reader sees six columns where the workbook has eight

page.basis: holds on 341 of the issued pages; the drifts in the set are single-sheet lapses, not the format
page.overflow_rule: an item that does not fit starts the next page. 46 is not a target.

page_codes.two_part_applies_to: a bill with no POMI section of its own - Dayworks, which is [GP9]
page_codes.note: a builder that assumes three parts cannot produce a dayworks bill

body.wrap_method: the builder breaks description text across consecutive rows of column C at the measured wrap width
body.why: a wrapped cell changes height, and a changed height breaks the 62-row page
body.figures_on: the first row of an item only

continuation_strings.note: the trailing-period variants are a minority in the issued set and are not reproduced

money_column_words.item: in F - the unit for a lump-sum item
money_column_words.Included: in H - priced within another item
money_column_words.N.A: in H - not applicable to this project
money_column_words.By OSE: in H - by others or owner-supplied

borders.warning: reproducing the page as a fully ruled grid is wrong

list_any_additional_items.position: closes a section, on its own page, immediately after the column head band
list_any_additional_items.layout: blank row between the heading and the paragraph, then two rule lines
list_any_additional_items.note: the trailing single space on lines 2 to 5 is in the issued file - keep it

collection.head_band: abbreviated - only C = ITEM DESCRIPTION and H = TOTAL PRICE / AED; no ITEM, QUANTITY, UNIT or RATE
collection.rows: one per page: 'Page {bill}/{section}/{n}' with H linking to that page's To Collection cell
collection.total_line: TOTAL FOR BILL NO. {bill}/{section}/{last page} - SECTION {L} - {TITLE}, / CARRIED TO SUMMARY  - {summary ref}
collection.total_line_note: the TOTAL FOR line ends with a comma and a trailing space and continues on the next row; CARRIED TO SUMMARY is followed by TWO spaces before the dash

bill_summary.rows: one per section - C the last page code, D the section title, H a link to that section sheet's TOTAL FOR cell
bill_summary.closes_with: TOTAL CARRIED TO FORM OF TENDER

grand_summary.rows: one per bill - C = BILL NO. {n}, D the bill title, H a link to that bill's summary total
closes_with: TOTAL CARRIED TO FORM OF TENDER

item_lettering.sequence: A, B, C ... within the page
item_lettering.known_defects_in_issued_set: nine pages break the rule - one uses I, one repeats A B A B, seven skip letters where a revision deleted an item and the sequence was never re-lettered. Those are defects in those pages, not in the rule.
